ValidationRule.description: Payment status changes must follow the documented lifecycle.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Status__c), NOT(OR(AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Draft"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Queued"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Cancelled"))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Queued"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Processing"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Cancelled"))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Processing"), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Succeeded"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Failed"))), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), "Failed"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Queued")))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Payment status cannot make that transition.
